name: List All Bills
description: Returns all bills that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter bills updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtTo]
queryFilters.description: Filter bills updated at or before this date-time.

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by bill ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of Bill objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bill

responseFields.name: data[].AccountNumber
responseFields.description: For utility billing. The account number associated with the bill, used by a utility vendor to identify the account

responseFields.name: data[].ApprovalStatus
responseFields.description: Indicates the bill's approval status

responseFields.name: data[].CashAccountId
responseFields.description: The general ledger account ID of the Cash Account the bill will be paid out of. If the property is corporate, the CashAccountID must be a corporate gl account. If it is not, it cannot be a corporate GL account

responseFields.name: data[].CheckMemo
responseFields.description: The memo on the check

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A description or summary of the bill

responseFields.name: data[].DueDate
responseFields.description: The date the bill is due

responseFields.name: data[].InvoiceDate
responseFields.description: The date the invoice was received

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the bill was last updated

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems
responseFields.description: Array of line item attributes present on the bill(s)

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bill line item

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].Amount
responseFields.description: The amount due for the line item. Valid format is "DD.CC", e.g. "23.33"

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief description of the line item

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: The general ledger account ID relevant to the line item. UUID format e.g. "d9009724-9f32-11ec-bc31-d46a96ab9b08"

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: The PropertyId associated with the line item. UUID format e.g. "d9009724-9f32-11ec-bc31-d46a96ab9b08"

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].ServiceFrom
responseFields.description: The start date of the utility vendor's service. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD"

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].ServiceTo
responseFields.description: The end date of the utility vendor's service. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD"

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems[].UnitId
responseFields.description: The unit ID relevant to the line item. UUID format e.g. "914a2a8e-f5d3-11e9-a485-1876da4c83b5"

responseFields.name: data[].ManagementCompanyAsPayee
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the management company is the payee for the bill

responseFields.name: data[].TotalAmount
responseFields.description: The total amount due for the bill. Ensure that the total amount is equal to the total of all line items summed.

responseFields.name: data[].VendorId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the payee's vendor ID

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
